summary: Frontend-only validation of the new live-camera capture flow in Evaluator. Used page.add_init_script to shim navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with a canvas.captureStream (fake stream) for the happy path and with a NotAllowedError-throwing shim for the denied path. All six scenarios pass: (1) camera-btn opens camera-dialog which mounts in the DOM (verified via querySelector), (2) live <video> element renders and camera-capture-btn becomes enabled once the stream is ready, (3) clicking Capture cards posts multipart image to /api/recognize-cards (observed POST -> 200) and the dialog closes, (4) DOM state confirmed with 4752 chars of dialog HTML and no page errors (only a benign Radix aria-describedby warning), (5) permission-denied path shows CameraOff icon + error message + camera-retry-btn (Try again), no crash, (6) regression: existing scan-photo-btn / photo-input upload with /tmp/test_cards.jpg still posts to /api/recognize-cards (200), populates the 4 slots and auto-evaluates (decision-panel visible with score 5/9 PLAYABLE).

issues: React/Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking a11y warning - add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby on DialogContent in CameraCapture.jsx.

action_items: Optional a11y: add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside CameraCapture DialogContent to silence the Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.snap() silently no-ops if video.videoWidth is 0 (stream not ready yet). Because the capture button is disabled until ready=true this is fine in practice, but a defensive user-facing toast (e.g. 'Camera not ready yet') would be nicer than a silent failure.
CameraCapture.start() sets ready=true only if videoRef.current exists at play() time; in the current mount order this works, but the effect intentionally re-runs only on open change - fine as-is.
Evaluator.processImage is defined without useCallback and is passed as onCapture prop, causing CameraCapture to re-render on every parent render. Minor perf nit only.
Consider surfacing an in-dialog error state when recognizeCards returns non-4-card response (currently only a toast fires after the dialog has closed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright browser used by the automation tool does not accept custom Chromium flags (--use-fake-device-for-media-stream). Instead, override navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia via page.add_init_script BEFORE page.goto with a canvas.captureStream(30) to simulate a live video track. For permission-denied testing, add a second init script that throws a NotAllowedError. Both approaches successfully exercised the CameraCapture dialog end-to-end against the real backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. /api/recognize-cards returned 200 for both the fake canvas frame and the real /tmp/test_cards.jpg.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the live-camera feature.
